lines.text: So the ankle went over playing five a side on Tuesday night?
Yeah, I'm coming in with a swollen left ankle, it ballooned straight away.
Bruising along the outer side and tender in front of the ankle bone, but you managed four steps, so there's no fracture to worry about.
Strap it for the next few days and keep it raised when you're sat down, and no football for two weeks.
Ta-ra then, mind how you go.
Now then duck, come on in, sit yourself down.
Ta. My shoulder's been locking up when I reach for the top shelf.
